tasks.title: Update PUT /api/config/:key response to return full config
tasks.description: Modify the PUT /api/config/:key handler in src/api/config.ts to return the full config object (agentTimeout, maxConcurrentAgents, pollInterval) after setting the value, instead of just { key, value }. Call configService.getConfig() after configService.set() and include it in the response data.
acceptanceCriteria: PUT /api/config/agent.timeout with { value: 2700000 } returns { success: true, data: { agentTimeout: 2700000, maxConcurrentAgents: 8, pollInterval: 30000 } }
PUT /api/config/agent.maxConcurrent with invalid value (e.g. 20) returns 400 with validation error message
GET /api/config still works unchanged
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow design D1: replace { key, value } response with configService.getConfig() result

tasks.title: Add frontend types, API client methods, and React Query hooks for config
tasks.description: Add GeneralConfig interface to types.ts, add getConfig and updateConfig methods to api.ts, and add useConfig query + useUpdateConfig mutation hooks to useQueries.ts. The useUpdateConfig hook should follow the optimistic update pattern (onMutate update cache, onError rollback, onSettled invalidate) matching the existing useSaveProvider pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: types.ts exports GeneralConfig interface with agentTimeout, maxConcurrentAgents, pollInterval (all number)
api.ts has getConfig() calling GET /api/config returning GeneralConfig
api.ts has updateConfig(key, value) calling PUT /api/config/:key returning GeneralConfig
useQueries.ts exports useConfig() hook returning { data, isLoading, error }
useQueries.ts exports useUpdateConfig() mutation with optimistic cache update on ['config'] key
useUpdateConfig onMutate sets ['config'] cache optimistically, onError rolls back
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Query key: ['config']. Follow useSaveProvider pattern for optimistic updates.

tasks.title: Build GeneralSettingsSection component and wire into SettingsPage
tasks.description: Create GeneralSettingsSection component with three validated form fields (Agent Timeout in minutes, Max Concurrent Agents count, Poll Interval in seconds). Each field has a Save button that calls useUpdateConfig. Include frontend validation (timeout >= 1min, maxConcurrent 1-16, pollInterval >= 5sec). Add Reset to Defaults button with window.confirm dialog. Replace the 'General settings coming soon' placeholder in SettingsPage General tab with <GeneralSettingsSection />.
acceptanceCriteria: General tab shows Agent Timeout (minutes), Max Concurrent Agents, Poll Interval (seconds) fields loaded from GET /api/config
Values display in user units: agentTimeout/60000 min, maxConcurrentAgents count, pollInterval/1000 sec
Each field has inline Save button that calls PUT /api/config/:key with converted ms value
Frontend validation blocks invalid values (timeout<1min, maxConcurrent<1 or >16, pollInterval<5sec, non-numeric) with error messages
Save failure shows error and reverts field to previous value
Reset to Defaults button with confirm dialog resets all three to defaults (30/8/30)
Loading state shown while config fetches, error state with retry button on fetch failure
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow design D2 (extract standalone component), D4 (per-field save), D5 (display units in state). Match existing SettingsPage styling (Tailwind classes, gray-50 backgrounds).

acceptanceCriteria: Old 'coming soon' placeholder test is removed or updated
Test verifies General tab renders Agent Timeout, Max Concurrent, Poll Interval fields with mock config data
